notes: Update can no longer stall on a hidden keypress prompt
patch_notes:
Fixed the updater stall: build.bat no longer waits for a keypress when run by the update helper (auto mode), so an unattended update finishes instead of hanging forever.
The update helper now logs the build to update_build.log, so a failed build leaves evidence.
After a successful build, the fresh exe is copied back over the copy that was actually launched, so a pinned or standalone copy can never resurrect the old version.
